landscape_environment.note: Mountain summit, rocky country and cave-like terrain are explicit landscape evidence.

season_weather_time.note: Rain and evening-time (`எற்படு பொழுது`) are explicit weather/time evidence.

flora.note: `கோடல் கண்ணி` is retained as source floral/adornment material without modern taxonomic expansion.

fauna.note: Deer, mate/pair and tiger are retained as exact source fauna.

people_social_roles.note: Companions, others in poverty, ruler/assembly participant and exact `குறவர் பெருமகன்` are retained.

relationships.note: Relations to companions, others, assembly and the speaker's ruler are explicit.

emotion_lived_experience.note: Forbearance and shame at others' helplessness/poverty are explicit lived-emotional evidence.

clothing_ornaments_adornment.note: `கோடல் கண்ணி` is retained as explicit garland/adornment evidence.

material_culture_everyday_objects.note: Bow, spear and garland are explicit material objects.

weapons_warfare.note: Army blame, bow and killing spear are explicit martial evidence.

polity_political_life.note: Army reputation and conduct in the king's assembly are explicit polity evidence.

communities_social_groups.note: `குறவர் பெருமகன்` and printed `குறவர் குடியினன்` are retained exactly without later identity substitution.

values_ethical_concepts.note: Forbearance, shame, avoidance of army disgrace and assembly excellence are explicit ethical/value claims.
